Customer API introduction

Own store

Manage products, orders, and inventory across partner marketplaces from your own store.
Manage partner marketplace products, confirm orders, and register waybills from your own store with one click. You can also check inventory accurately for products sold in your own store and partner marketplaces.

Key features of the customer API

  • Register a product once in your own store and send it to partner marketplaces!
  • Manage sale status, sale periods, sale price updates, and detailed descriptions from your own store!
  • View all partner marketplace orders in your own store at once!
  • Handle partner marketplace order confirmation, waybill registration, and waybill transmission in bulk from your own store!
  • Check inventory and update partner marketplace stock from your own store in one operation!

Representative customers using the customer API

Marketplace API introduction

Shoplinker has one of the industry's largest seller bases, with about 4,500 sellers and a product database, and is ready to partner with your business. Developing a Shoplinker marketplace API gives sellers on your marketplace convenient product/order management and helps increase sales by bringing in Shoplinker sellers.

Key features of the marketplace API

Access to product databases of sellers using Shoplinker
Reduce costs by reducing product sourcing work through merchandisers
Increase sales by growing seller and product databases
Ongoing marketplace exposure in Shoplinker increases awareness

Representative customers using the marketplace API

ERP automation service introduction

What is ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)? ERP integrates business management, human resources, finance, production, and other enterprise systems to improve productivity and efficiency. Solutions include Douzone, Ecount, and in-house ERP, and many companies use ERP systems.

  1. Waybill and data transmission (Excel, API calls) Send data (batch)
  2. Waybill and data transmission Send data (API call)

  2. Shoplinker & ERP providers
